column1: # Keep nvs at 0x9000 (matches IDF default) so existing device IDs survive
# re-flash. coredump partition (64 KB) captures panic dumps for post-mortem
# 2026-09-08: factory grown 1M → 1536K for the MQTT/TLS stack (docs/48 Tier 1):
# the previous image was ~960 KB of a 1024 KB app slot; esp_mqtt + esp-tls +
# mbedtls X.509 + full CA bundle add ~150 KB. nvs offset untouched (device ID
# survives); coredump moves later in flash — old dumps are lost on re-flash.
# leaves ~400 KB spare on 2 MB flash.
